name: Hambantota Herbal Park
description: Discover the serene Hambantota Herbal Park, a tranquil tea estate where ancient plants whisper secrets of nature. Nestled in Southern Sri Lanka, this lush garden offers a peaceful escape from the hustle, perfect for those seeking a slice of tranquility amidst the rolling hills and vibrant flora.

name: Tissamaharama Organic Farm
description: Discover the serene Tissamaharama Organic Farm, nestled amidst lush tea plantations. This organic estate offers a glimpse into sustainable agriculture practices, perfect for nature lovers and eco-conscious travelers seeking a tranquil escape.
activities: Explore the organic tea gardens, Learn about sustainable farming practices, Visit the farm shop for locally made products

name: Sooriyawewa Spice Trail
description: Experience the Sooriyawewa Spice Trail, a serene tea estate where aromatic spices grow amidst lush greenery. Nestled in the Southern Province, this historic site offers a glimpse into Sri Lanka’s rich agricultural heritage, perfect for nature lovers and tea enthusiasts.
activities: Tea tasting, Spice plantation tour, Photography
monsoon_note: May–Aug SW monsoon; A2 highway may flood

name: Suriyawewa Botanics
description: Discover the lush tea gardens of Suriyawewa Botanics, a serene estate where ancient tea trees whisper tales of Sri Lanka’s rich agricultural heritage. Nestled in the Southern Province, this picturesque site offers visitors a glimpse into the country's traditional tea-making process and the vibrant culture that surrounds it.
activities: Tea plantation tour, Photography, Tea tasting

name: Lunugamvehera Herb Walk
description: Discover the lush herb walk at Lunugamvehera Herb Walk, a serene tea estate where visitors can explore over 100 species of aromatic herbs under the watchful gaze of ancient tea trees. This tranquil spot offers a unique glimpse into Sri Lanka’s rich botanical heritage.
activities: Herb identification, Tea plantation tour, Herbal tea tasting

name: Ridiyagama Estate
description: Ridiyagama Estate stands as a picturesque tea plantation, nestled amidst lush greenery and traditional Sri Lankan architecture. Visitors can explore the estate’s serene gardens, learn about the tea-making process, and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding hills.
activities: Explore tea gardens, Learn about tea-making process, Enjoy panoramic views
monsoon_note: May–Aug SW monsoon; A2 highway may flood
